title: Pharmacophore-Based Compound Filtering
description: Extract a pharmacophore model from known active compounds and screen a compound library for pharmacophore matches.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

reference_actives.description: SMILES file of known active compounds (one per line) used to derive the pharmacophore model.

compound_library.description: SMILES or SDF file of compounds to screen against the pharmacophore.

min_features.description: Minimum number of pharmacophore features a compound must match to pass. 3 = reasonable selectivity.

generate_3d.description: Generate 3D conformers for distance-based pharmacophore matching. Slower but more accurate.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
